reviewMethod: Independent visual inspection of all 20 original paper pages and scheme PDF pages 37–72, including every model, alternative, diagram, scale, component allocation and detailed credit note. All 43 question and 43 solution crops inspected.
sourceNotes: All 20 original paper pages and scheme pages 37–72 independently visually inspected. 43 published tasks; both Q6A and Q6B geometry routes retained. 325 offered/practice marks, 300 candidate marks.

Q3(b) requests two methods under one 5B scale, with no finite printed option pool. All four model approaches retained in Q3(c). Q7(c)(ii) is one multiple-choice answer task with all A–E statements: D full credit, B/C partial credit.

Q8 detailed task notes supersede its inconsistent summary table: part (a) scales 5B,15D*,15D*,5B*,10D and part (b) 10C*,15D*. Ten starred tasks only: Q2(b)(iii), all Q5 parts, Q8(a)(ii,iii,iv), Q8(b)(i,ii).
The Q6A(a)(i) model incorrectly repeats tangent instead of radius. Preserve original and disclose the correct geometrical result beside it.

This paper asks for the trapezoidal rule in Q8(b)(ii), unlike the parallel Phase 1 paper’s Simpson rule. Correct original model and task retained. All original source diagrams, scales, tables and dependent stems remain available.
